I can do that in that order. The hotel remains cancellable until 6:00 p.m. local time on Monday, August 28. I’ll also request late checkout without making it a condition of the reservation. Shall I use the payment method already on file for both bookings?
Yes, use the card on file. Go ahead with the flights now.

Now book the hotel. Note that flight 2186 lands at 10:18 and that I should reach the property around 10:50.

Finish with one clean itinerary and make sure the total does not count the rideshares as already paid.

Confirmed itinerary: Wednesday, August 30, nonstop MSP–RDU, 6:45–10:18 p.m.; rideshare to the hotel with arrival expected around 10:50 p.m.; two hotel nights through Friday, September 1; Friday rideshare from the office in time for the nonstop RDU–MSP flight, 5:35–7:48 p.m. Paid reservations total $1,105: $584 airfare plus $521 lodging. Rideshares remain an unpaid estimate of $118, making the projected trip total $1,223. Both reservations are confirmed, and the hotel has the flight and late-arrival details.
